name: Intergalactic Championship
epitaph: An open championship the Commission built its whole promotion around, won for the first time in a four-way dream match at the ULTRATITLE finale and changing hands for the first time in a bloodied main event that ended its inaugural champion's 146-day reign.

name: Intergalactic Team Championships of the Universe
notes: Introduced for the Unlucky For Some 2013 tour and contested through a series of qualifying matches; no reign is recorded in the held record.
epitaph: A team championship introduced for IGC's own Unlucky For Some 2013 tour, its qualifying series still underway when the record read this pass goes quiet.
